summary: b2-integration made the five brief-2 pieces one app, closed every leftover cross-agent item and verified the brief end to end on real data (API 8716 with FIRE3D_LIVE=0, Vite 5185; built fires only; nothing built by me: 0 non-GET requests in every browser run and 0 POST in the API log). Checklist items: (1) returnToIncident already framed the fire via frameFire (shell); the stale CONTRACT map text was corrected. (2) Official fits no longer change the open fire: fitOfficialBounds and the Layers drawer's zone fit pass MapFlyTo.source 'official'; map/focus.ts adds FocusHold + focusUnlessHeld; MapController holds the zoom focus until the user's next move (gesture, wheel, keys, zoom buttons), another explicit flight or framing, or an incident change, and cancels a focus change pending in the store. Henderson's 'Show' on the Orange County order (inside Norte's area) now keeps Henderson; the next user zoom resumes the rule. MapLibre starts a wheel zoom without originalEvent, so the hold also ends on a user moveend. (3) OfficialNow's California variant was already mounted in the overview panel (shell). (4) --m-chip-w 380 / --m-card-w 360 were already set; coverage re-measured. (5) Duplicate ImageryPanel: both copies shared the radio group name 'xs-imagery' (a real cross-talk bug); each list now has its own group (useId), and on wide screens the Layers drawer shows ImageryLayerSummary (image shown, not live, time/age/pixel/cloud, opacity, credit, pointer to the chip's 'More images'); phones keep the full list in the drawer (the chip is hidden while a sheet is open). (6) Public never says 'hindcast': forecastDescription(f, mode, { plain }) ('Model re-run on past weather'), the Layers drawer notes, the view-switch and Analysis-drawer tips, the replay stop description, and the Analysis drawer's charts in Public ('Model forecast' / 'Model re-run', no run ids; Command and Forensic keep 'Forecast <run id>', P50, P10-P90). The Forensic switch is relabelled 'Prepare analysis when I pick an unprepared fire'. (7) The API client already asked for year=2026 and year=2025 and all three lists stay loaded. (8) Lint stays at the 55-warning src/scene baseline. Fixes found by the verification: (a) decision 10 'panning switches the focus' failed between neighbouring fires whose analysis areas overlap (Henderson -> Norte never switched): focusTarget now also switches when the view centre is inside another prepared fire's area and outside the open fire's (hysteresis kept elsewhere). (b) The coordinator's clarity note: NWS outlines are now thin and quiet (1.4/1.2 px dashed/dotted, opacity 0.85 -> 0.4 by zoom, light casing, sparse labels), a selected NWS alert is drawn in its own colour with a faint fill below the fire layers instead of a heavy white outline, and the outline labels moved below the fire layers. (c) Layer stacking bug: after every basemap load the evacuation zones and NWS outlines were drawn ABOVE the fire layers (MapLibre fires 'styledata', where the shared LayerGroupHandle re-added them below the labels, before 'style.load', where map-core re-adds its fire layers underneath); extras/mapLayers.ts now moves existing layers back on the forced style.load sync, verified on dark/roads/aerial. (d) The phone card dropped the issuer and own time of a listed zone, 'not an all-clear' and the NWS sender/archive label/link: kept now (standing rule for official items). (e) The phone timeline's stale line wrapped into four squeezed columns; it now wraps in reading order. CONTRACT §8, §12.3 and §13 (shell, official-web, map, location, new 'integration' sub-heading) were updated for every change. Final screenshots: 30 brief2-final-*.png, all viewed.

MapFlyTo.source 'official' semantics as wired: the zoom focus is held (FocusHold, focusUnlessHeld) from the official flight until the user's next move, another explicit flight or framing, or an incident change; orbit buttons keep the hold. Not a time limit.
